record.question: Aspiration cytology of lung is usually carried out under:
record.explanation: Answer C: CT guided. For percutaneous aspiration/biopsy of a lung lesion, CT guidance is a common standard because it localizes the target through the aerated lung; exact guidance depends on lesion location and access route. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK563153/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3140242/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
